title: Relationship Terms: Operating Credit and the Equipment & Vehicle Loans Post-Release Margin — Questions and Answers
content:
**Rule.** The post-release margin of an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan is widened or narrowed by the member's operating credit: 4 points are added when the member holds an operating line in active status and none of the member's operating lines carries a late charge dated less than 12 whole months before; 4 points are taken off when the member holds an operating line in active status and one of the member's operating lines carries such a late charge; and nothing changes when the member holds no operating line in active status.

**Which records decide the points?**
The member's Operating Lines of Credit: the status of each line, and the late-charge fee entries in the lines' transaction history dated less than 12 whole months before the test date.

**How many points apply?**

| Operating line in active status | Late charge on any of the member's operating lines within 12 whole months | Points to the post-release margin |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no | 4 added |
| yes | yes | -4 |
| no | either | none |

**Does a suspended or matured line count as a line in active status?**
No. Only a line whose status is active counts; a member whose lines are all suspended, matured or closed takes no points.

**Hypothetical.** A Used Equipment Loan member (limit after release 75 percent) with an active operating line and no line late charge in the past 12 months has a margin of 79 percent; with one such late charge, 71 percent.
